scripts._prebuild: guides.php is contact.php's allowlist AND the download email's copy, generated from the same resource records that build the guide pages. It has to be written before astro build so it is in public/ when dist/ is assembled.
scripts._postbuild: The 301 maps are part of the deployable output. Without this they are generated only when somebody remembers to run them by hand, and since dist/ is rebuilt from scratch every time, they never reached the server at all.
scripts._assert:inventory: The other direction from assert:urls. That one asks whether every URL in the inventory resolves; this asks what names a URL the inventory has never heard of. assert:urls passed 196/196 while a live, indexed case study was about to 404.
scripts._assert:held-back: Twelve case studies are noindex. This fails the build if an indexed page offers one as proof from a cases, featured or anchor block — nine cards across eight pages did.
scripts._assert:mobile: Five phone widths, and the questions assert-overlap does not ask: tap targets under 24px, type under 10px, and content off the right edge. Found the case-study back link at 22px tall.
scripts._verify:journal-redirects: Static half only. The live half needs network access to the site, which the build agent does not have; run `node scripts/verify-journal-redirects.mjs --live` from somewhere that does.
scripts._verify:server: Status codes, headers and redirect chains are properties of the nginx config, not of dist/, so this is NOT in `npm run verify` — the build agent cannot reach either host. Run it from a machine that can: `npm run verify:server -- https://dev.roarsinc.com`, and after cutover `npm run verify:server -- https://www.roarsinc.com --live`.
scripts._verify: assert:urls runs LAST. It is red on purpose until the seven UK location pages get a URL pattern, and && short-circuits — with it first, every gate after it silently stopped running.
scripts.verify: npm run validate:redirects && npm run validate:content && npm run build && npm run assert:styles && npm run assert:attribution && npm run assert:journal && npm run assert:overlap && npm run assert:assets && npm run assert:inventory && npm run assert:held-back && npm run assert:mobile && npm run verify:journal-redirects && npm run assert:urls
scripts.test: npm run test:content && npm run test:components && npm run test:homepage
